name: Virginia Equipment Distributors Inc
old_description: Based in Orange, Virginia since 1984, Virginia Equipment Distributors, Inc., specializes in heavy equipment sales and rentals. Our inventory includes excavators, skidsteers, tractors, trailers, dump trucks, front-end loaders, bulldozers, and much more.
about:
Virginia Equipment Distributors, Inc. has operated from Orange, Virginia since 1984. The business is owned and operated by Kent Higginbotham, with Robert Higginbotham overseeing administration and Hunter Hemp leading the sales team. The company positions itself as Central Virginia's heavy equipment sales and rental resource.

The firm specializes in both sales and rentals of heavy equipment, carrying a broad inventory that includes excavators, skid steers, tractors, trailers, dump trucks, front-end loaders, bulldozers, commercial trucks, commercial trailers, agricultural equipment, and construction attachments. This range allows it to supply machinery for earthmoving, material handling, and hauling applications.

Its customers come primarily from the construction, agriculture, and commercial transportation industries. Contractors, farmers, and fleet operators in central Virginia and beyond rely on the distributor for equipment that supports site development, field work, and over-the-road logistics.
